budget_estimate.basis: Estimate only. Fixed input per model request from docs/EVALUATION_COST.md (lean 7,070; native about 15,100); #309 luna lean run measured 7,444 input / 32 output per interpretation. Content ~ chars/4 of wrapper+messages, 120 output tokens per answer; a solvable D turn counted as two model requests (tool call + answer) plus 250 tokens of MCP tool schema; grading batch 2 with per-case material ~ chars/4 of the case + 1,800 for three responses, transcripts and verdicts; 5% single-case re-grades.

decision_rule: frozen decision.json (run_319 operationalization): ADOPT iff protection gate passes AND correct locally restored result >= 80% of A-eligible tool_solvable cases AND one-sided exact sign test (D correct vs C all-pass, solvable cases) p < 0.05 AND <= 1 A-eligible no_calculation/impossible case has a D tool call AND no C/D trajectory leaks an original or computed value AND no duplicated inference; otherwise REJECT
ungraded: one single-case re-grade after a failed quote check; remaining ungraded cases are bounded: the decision stands only if identical when every ungraded case is excluded, D-wins, C-wins, both-fail or both-pass; otherwise UNDECIDED_RERUN_UNGRADED
limitations: Interpreter and grader are the same model family.
Same OS user; no hard filesystem jail for the MCP fixture.
Results are not comparable to the 2.11.1 gpt-6.1-sol run (model and transport differ).
